question: For any real number $x$, let $[x]$ denote the largest integer less than or equal to $x$ and $\langle xangle=x-[x]$, that is, the fractional part of $x$. For arbitrary real numbers $x,y$ and $z$, only one of the following statements is correct. Which one is it?

options.C: $\langle x+y+zangle=\langle y+z-[y+z]+\langle xangleangle$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
